# Ebda Chat (ابدأ شات)

Ebda Chat (ابدأ شات) is a shared customer inbox on WhatsApp, made by Ebda AI Studio (ابدأ ستوديو للذكاء الاصطناعي), the Egyptian studio at https://ebda.app. It runs on Meta's official WhatsApp Business Platform. This host, https://wa.ebda.app, is the Ebda Chat app: a sign-in is required, so there are no public product pages here.

Ebda Chat belongs to a store owner's Ebda Store: the owner connects it from the store's Settings, and that creates the Chat workspace only (no charge, no plan change, no message sent). It then gives a team one inbox for customer chats, orders and cash-on-delivery confirmations linked to the store, consent-based campaigns, and an AI agent.

Not to be confused with any unrelated product with a similar name.
